narrative.overview:
Vera N is a design annual's plate section. Every note is a plate on uncoated stock, ruled by a single hairline; the user's words are printed in ink that is never pure black or pure white; and the only hue in the whole book is a quiet periwinkle seal that the on-device AI uses to sign what it proposes. What the user confirmed is solid ink. What the AI suggests is open, dashed and sealed, so its voice is always recognisable and never loud.

Light is near-white stock with plates a shade warmer. Dark is the same section printed on black stock, composed rather than inverted: the ground stays cool, the plates sit in the ivory family, and the ink is ivory. Both themes follow the system setting. The world is colour-and-role only: layout, type, radii and spacing predate it and were deliberately left as they were.

The world is flat by the user's explicit choice. It refuses the near-black-plus-one-bright-accent dark app and the cream-and-serif notebook.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks and a seal: ink for the user, secondary ink for metadata, periwinkle only for the AI.
Solid ink plate means chosen or confirmed: primary action, active tab or filter, confirmed chip, caret.
Plates ruled by 1px hairlines; no shadows, gradients, glow or texture.
Generous, fully rounded pills and 24px card corners, unchanged from the incumbent app.
Dark is composed, not inverted: cool ground, warm ivory plates.

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Periwinkle belongs to the AI. It appears only on suggestions (dashed outlines, the waiting dot, the connections mark, graph suggestion lines) and never on anything the user confirmed, never as a button, link or brand colour.

rules.name: The Open Plate Rule
rules.body: "Dimmed" means an empty fill, a secondary-ink label and a dashed seal outline at full strength. Do not fade the dashes: a faded seal measured 2.1:1 in light and read grey in dark. Meaning never relies on colour alone.

rules.name: The Ink Plate Rule
rules.body: A solid ink plate means chosen: the primary action, the selected tab or filter, a confirmed chip. Never use it decoratively.

rules.name: The Mirror Rule
rules.body: Android resources drawn outside Flutter (`values/colors.xml`, `values-night/colors.xml`: launch background, widget card, border, text, secondary text, accent) carry the exact palette values. Change both together.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is the wordmark and nothing else.

rules.name: The Inline Mark Rule
rules.body: In the editor, confirmed links are body text with a 2px ink underline; bold is Inter 700; a ticked checklist item is secondary ink, struck through. Read-only text on screen draws checklists as □ / ✓ (Inter has no ☐ / ☑ and Android would fall back to colour emoji); text that leaves the screen keeps ☐ / ☑.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: A plate is separated from the stock by colour and a 1px hairline, never by a shadow. If something needs to read as raised, it is a sheet with a scrim, not a shadow.

dos: **Do** use the seal (#6266B0 / #A7AAE8) only for AI marks, at full strength.
**Do** show a suggestion as an empty fill, secondary-ink label and dashed seal outline, so meaning never relies on colour.
**Do** use a solid ink plate for the one primary action and for whatever is selected or confirmed.
**Do** separate plates from the stock with tone and a 1px hairline.
**Do** keep Android's native colour resources identical to the palette in both themes.
**Do** keep text at 4.5:1 and controls, including dashed outlines, at 3:1 or better in both themes.
donts: **Don't** use periwinkle for buttons, links, brand moments or anything the user confirmed.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients, glows or texture; the two existing preview and bottom fades are the only fades.
**Don't** use pure black or pure white for ink or ground.
**Don't** invert light into dark; dark plates stay warm ivory-family, never cool graphite.
**Don't** use Instrument Serif for anything but the wordmark.
